full_page.content:
Page 18 Cont.
Jan. Josephine Saincome - 64 - of Pontiac (235 Rockwell) - lung cancer - sickly for two yrs. - 7 months in bed - gave special enrollment some two months ago for Poor Souls. To-day her daughter, Maxine finished up the $50. (35.)
Frances McGee- 38 - lukemia ..... in Carmel Hospital
Geo Crane - 48 - n.c. - pneumonia and threatening sist on back of neck:unable to sleep for quite a time.
Mrs. Catherine Foley - 59 - asks prayers for her twin sons - they were just a month old when their father went away to the W. War No. 1 and just a year old when he was killed in service. Now the one is in Cleveland hospital from shrapnel wound received in France last June - Expecting serious operation shortly. The other twin is on way overseas to Germany.
Page 19 Jan. 16 Leo De Guise - 7 - and Ronald Walker - 10 - from Flint, very small for their age .... "nothing seems to help. We enrolled them Today in Ser. Masses.
Mary C. Edrman of Ft. Wayne, Ind ..... Eczema, etc ...
17
Mary Kajda - 35 - internal tumor (rectum) bad circulation.
Flying Officer James A. Sherry - 22 - formerly of Assumption College and Organist "Missing in Action" over Germany" day before New Years. - had been hoping shortly to resume his studies for the holy priesthood. Marie Schultz = 9 - struck by truck before Christmas and is ever since unconscious.
Mrs. Virginia Hardoin - 24 - very lame side and back, doctor - for near a year. Enrolled.
Page 20 Jan. 19 Mrs. Mary Rudd - 54 - arthritis and in one finger threatened ostiomi- litis.
Baby John Tim Kolberg - 3 -fluid in brain - on back for two yrs. - quiet even playful but entirely helpless and blind. - Enrolled 10.00
Robert Bloink - 39 - bad heart- condition - has 80-yr .- old mother to keep and wife and her blind brother besides two daughters 7 and 10.
